method: byte-count comparison of three retrieval arms for the same function node, run on a fixed node list at a pinned commit
motivation: CLAUDE.md instructed agents to prefer `bitcode context` over reading a file, citing 'measured 41% fewer tokens'. That 41.0% figure is from docs/authoring-cost.md -- plan-authoring prompt tokens, text-addressed vs graph-addressed, 5 of 8 paired tasks, under a policy that FAILED overall. No measurement of `bitcode context` against reading a file existed. This policy measures the claim that was actually being made.

read.command_template: <read the whole file containing the node>
read.metric: byte count of the file named by the node's `file` field in `bitcode inspect --json`
read.rationale: What an agent's Read tool returns when it opens the file to see one function. The honest baseline for 'instead of reading the file'.

context.rationale: The command CLAUDE.md actually told agents to run. Its output carries a Plan Format v2 JSON Schema and plan skeleton in addition to the node source.

source_only.rationale: Retrieval without the authoring envelope: the selected nodes' {path, language, source} and nothing else. Added by this measurement because the `context` arm's fixed envelope was the suspected cost.

node_selection.rule: Every Function node in the graph of this repository at source_commit, sorted by (source span bytes, node path), sampled at each 10th percentile: index floor(i * n / 10) for i in 0..10. Pinned explicitly below so the list cannot drift with the graph.
node_selection.rationale: Deciles by source size rather than hand-picked nodes: the envelope overhead this measurement is testing is a fixed cost, so it matters most for the small functions that make up most of a real codebase. The median Function node here is 549 bytes. Cherry-picking large functions would flatter the tool.

threshold.metric: aggregate byte reduction of the source_only arm against the read arm, summed across all nodes
threshold.rationale: Matches the 40% bar already established in docs/authoring-cost.md and reused by docs/names-cost-policy.json.

reported_but_not_gated: aggregate byte reduction of the context arm against the read arm
per-node reduction for both arms, including any node where an arm is larger than reading the file
